name: Condition filter (New/Open Box/Pre-owned) hides other conditions

steps.snapshotHint: Look for condition pills — .fgroup with condition labels like 'New', 'Open Box', 'Pre-owned'

steps.script: (() => { const pills = document.querySelectorAll('.cond-pill'); const conditions = new Set(); pills.forEach(p => conditions.add(p.textContent.trim())); return { conditions: [...conditions], count: pills.length }; })()
steps.description: After filtering, visible condition pills should only show the selected condition

businessContext: Condition filter is critical for price-sensitive customers choosing between new and used
